units.source_text: 八月二十六日是彼岸会圆满之日，又是宜于婚嫁的吉日，

en.t: August 26 was the day the Higan service came to its close, and it was also an auspicious day for weddings,

units.source_text: 薰君悄悄地做好准备，偷偷地带匂亲王到宇治去了。

en.t: so Kaoru quietly made all the preparations and secretly took Prince Niou to Uji.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的母亲明石皇后严禁匂亲王微行，如果被她知道，可不得了。

en.t: Prince Niou's mother, the Akashi Empress, strictly forbade him to go out in disguise, and if she found out, it would be disastrous.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王热切盼望，薰君只得秘密帮助他，事情确是很困难的。

en.t: But Prince Niou longed for it so earnestly that Kaoru had no choice but to help him in secret, though the matter was truly difficult.

units.source_text: 此次不到对岸夕雾左大臣那个壮丽的山庄中借宿，故不须乘舟渡河。

en.t: This time they would not stay at the splendid villa of Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, on the opposite bank, so there was no need to cross the river by boat.

units.source_text: 两人偷偷地来到附近薰君的庄院内，匂亲王在此下车等待，

en.t: The two men secretly came to Kaoru's nearby estate, where Prince Niou got out of the carriage and waited,

units.source_text: 薰君独自先到八亲王山庄中去。

en.t: while Kaoru went on alone first to the Eighth Prince's mountain villa.

units.source_text: 此地不会有人看到而议论，只有那个值宿员彷徨来去，

en.t: Here there was no one to see them and start gossiping; only the night-duty attendant wandered back and forth,

units.source_text: 但想来此人也不会知道内情的。

en.t: but Kaoru thought that even this man would not know the truth of the matter.

units.source_text: 山庄中的人闻得中纳言大人到了，大家都来招待。

en.t: When the people at the villa heard that the Lord Middle Counselor had arrived, they all came to receive him.

units.source_text: 两女公子听见薰君又来，都很担心。

en.t: When the two young princesses heard that Kaoru had come again, they were both very anxious.

units.source_text: 但大女公子想：“我已向他表示过，叫他把心移向妹妹，我可放心了。”

en.t: But the elder princess thought, "I have already made it clear to him that he should turn his heart toward my younger sister, so I can be at ease."

units.source_text: 二女公子则以为薰君对姐姐的爱情殊深，不会移及我身。

en.t: The younger princess, however, believed that Kaoru's love for her elder sister was far too deep and would never turn toward her.

units.source_text: 然而自从那天晚上受了惊吓之后，对姐姐不像从前那样亲信，已有戒心了。

en.t: Yet ever since the fright she had suffered that night, she no longer trusted her sister as she once had and had already become wary.

units.source_text: 薰君凡有言语，本来都是由侍女传达的。

en.t: Any message from Kaoru had always been conveyed through the waiting women.

units.source_text: “今天怎么办呢？”侍女们很为难。

en.t: "What should we do today?" the waiting women wondered, greatly troubled.
